# LOOKFANTASTIC

> > LOOKFANTASTIC is a leading online beauty retailer offering 660+ brands across skincare, haircare, cosmetics, and fragrance with Beauty+ Rewards loyalty program.

LOOKFANTASTIC curates premium and accessible beauty products from major brands like Lancôme, Clinique, NARS, The Ordinary, ESPA, and Pureology. The platform combines ecommerce with beauty subscriptions, exclusive deals, and innovative beauty technology products.

## Key Topics

- Beauty Retail & Ecommerce
- Skincare Products
- Haircare Solutions
- Cosmetics & Makeup
- Fragrance Collections
- Beauty+ Rewards Program
- Premium Beauty Brands (Lancôme, Clinique, NARS)
- Accessible Beauty (The Ordinary, The Inkey List)
- Beauty Technology (FOREO, StylPro Wavelength LED Face Mask)
- Luxury Skincare (ESPA, Nuxe Sun, Lancaster)
- Specialty Haircare (Pureology)
- Iconic Products (Black Honey Almost Lipstick, La Vie Est Belle)
- Beauty Deals & Promotions
- Beauty Subscription Services
